game_concept: A action puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Cliffside Ledge, a narrow cliff ledge: the sherpa guide must handle snow leopards while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Palindrome Gate: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate.
theme: Frost Peaks – Cliffside Ledge: a narrow cliff ledge
core_gameplay_loop: In Cliffside Ledge, repeat each round: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate. Each round, a new thermal packs challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the gate value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 460 points of thermal packs by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 460, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 10 (extended tier): Palindrome Gate
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Palindrome Gate' (Week 8 slot 5), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Cliffside Ledge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gate changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow leopards in Cliffside Ledge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 460 within 57 seconds.
